title: Chapter 438 The Top Of The List Is Changed
content:
Chapter 438 The Top Of The List Is Changed

Feeling Lu Xue's gaze, the three of them trembled all over and spoke quickly.

"My younger generation Qinghai, I've met seniors."

"My younger generation, Xuan Si, have met seniors."

"My younger generation Bai Xu, I've met senior."

Lu Xue looked at the three of them, and after a while, she whispered: "There is not much time left, let's practice hard. I hope that in the next battle, we can see you four shine brightly."

After hearing Lu Xue's words, Qinghai and Xuan Si both smiled.

Then, Lu Xue's eyes remained on Bai Xu for a moment, and then took them back, "Go and do what you should do."

"Yes, senior, junior."

The four symbols of the Heavenly Demon soon left the City Lord's Mansion. The entire City Lord's Mansion was like a dreamy peerless secret realm, with rich energy emitting everywhere.

The countless phantoms of treasures appear in front of you from time to time, which is intoxicating.

No wonder Bai Ling Energy's strength has improved so rapidly in a short period of time.

Yu Guang from Qinghai secretly looked at Bai Ling, feeling a little envious of Bai Ling's opportunity.

It is really a blessing to be able to follow Lu Xue.

But, shouldn’t these brothers and sisters be together? Why did they suddenly separate?

Qinghai is not aware of Bai Xu and Bai Ling's affairs. To be precise, there are very few people who know about it. Bai Xu and Bai Ling did not say it, Lu Xue and Ao Qing would not say it. I am afraid that only the old man Duan Jian is the only one who is a man named Duan Jian. I will talk nonsense when I drink too much.

"Bai Ling, how did you follow Senior Lu Xue? Why didn't Bai Xu be with you?"

At this time, Xuan Si suddenly asked directly.

He really couldn't figure it out, so he couldn't help asking.

Qinghai didn't say anything, but he was also staring at Bai Ling, and a puzzled look appeared in the dragon's pupil.

Hearing Xuan Si’s question, Bai Ling was about to speak, and Bai Xu became anxious.

"What are you doing so much? Now the most urgent thing is to the genius list. I'm already the top spot. You guys should pay attention to it!"

Qinghai was slightly stunned. Thinking of the crying of Bai Ling and Bai Xu before, he immediately understood that something unknown story must have happened.

But he is not that gossipy person.

Bai Xu is right, the most urgent thing now is the list of geniuses.

Unexpectedly, Bai Xu had already reached the top of the list, and it seemed that they had to hold on to it.

"Brother, you are already at the top of the list. It's so amazing!"

Bai Ling gave Bai Xushu a thumbs up, showed a gentle smile, with curved eyebrows and eyes, which were very moving.

Bai Xu laughed and was about to speak.

Suddenly, Bai Xu's body began to fluctuate.

Feeling the changes in space, Bai Xu immediately realized that someone defeated Zhang Changfan and began to sprint to the top of the list.

Buzz —

The next moment, Bai Xu disappeared from the spot.

He was summoned by the genius list.

On the spot, Qinghai frowned slightly and said to the two people who were a little confused by him: "Let's go and have a look."

......

In the Huangcheng Square, everyone looked at the top of the Tianjiao List.

At this moment, the top name is still Bai Xu.

But everyone knew that it might not be the case soon.

Because just now, another genius appeared here not long ago.

That was a genius from the Holy Spirit Clan. It is said that it was an existence cultivated by the patriarch of the Holy Spirit Clan who had exhausted a lot of effort and personally.

At this time, it is on the list of geniuses.

The space trembled, and a figure appeared here.

It was Bai Xu who was summoned by the Tianjiao List to guard the list.

After a brief confusion, Bai Xu suddenly noticed sitting cross-legged in the distance, staring at his creatures.

He had long fluorescent hair, colorful and beautiful face, and could not tell the male or female. The most eye-catching thing about Bai Xu was his pair of spiritual eyes.

"My name is Lingqi, Bai Xu. Are you ready to meet your first failure?"

Ling Qi smiled slightly and said with a brisk tone.

Hearing such arrogant words, Bai Xu snorted coldly and said, "You are just determined to be able to eat me?"

Ling Qi nodded, "I wanted to make the finale, but unfortunately, I was impatient. I came just after the retreat ended."

While speaking, Ling Qi slowly stood up and walked towards Bai Xu.

At the same time, a breath slowly overflowed from the spirit and the body.

Supreme Realm.

"Wo Chao!"

Outside the Tianjiao List, Bai Ling and the other two arrived here soon.

The powerful people of the Heavenly Demon Clan felt the breath of Bai Ling and others and immediately gathered.

"You guys are here, my masters."

A powerful man from the Tiande Clan led by the leader said with relief.

Qinghai frowned, "How is it?"

The powerful man from the Heavenly Demon Clan sighed and said, "Young Master Bai Xu is afraid he will be defeated."

Upon hearing this, Xuan Si said in confusion: "Why are you so sure?"

The strong man from the Heavenly Demon Clan lowered his head slightly and sighed heavily again, "Because this time the one who came to challenge was a young supreme."

The Supreme Boy!

Xuan Si was slightly stunned and unconsciously looked at Qinghai.

Qinghai frowned and said nothing.

Bai Ling looked at the Tianjiao List with concern.

She followed Lu Xue and was naturally very clear about the rules of the Tianjiao List.

If your brother loses, he will inevitably be hit.

But at this moment, some strong men at the scene suddenly said, "It's not right, how long has it been."

The other strong men also frowned, "How long has it been? Are they chatting inside? Why hasn't they finished yet?"

Is it still necessary to fight in a prophet realm or a supreme realm?

Although they didn't need to fight, they all understood that Bai Xu could not surrender without a fight.

Because true geniuses all have their own arrogance.

Buzz —

At this moment, the genius list suddenly emitted light, and the top position suddenly became Lingqi.

"Is it finally over?"

The next moment, Bai Xu's weak figure appeared in the square.

"elder brother!"

Bai Ling rushed to Bai Xu's side.

But the strong men around stared at Bai Xu as if they were terrified.

Qinghai was stunned for a moment, and suddenly laughed loudly.

Even Bai Ling was slightly stunned.

The powerful Tian Yao tribe on the side could no longer help and laughed and said, "Eternal Life!"

Bai Xu has been promoted to the immortal realm.

The audience was suddenly in an uproar.

No wonder Bai Xu was able to hold on for so long, it turned out that Bai Xu had actually advanced to the realm in the battle.

At this time, Ling Qi's figure also appeared in the field.

He ignored everyone's gaze and looked at Bai Xu. After a long time, Ling Qi sighed softly: "The heroes in the world are like stars in the sky, and I am just one of them."

"If you have a chance, I hope you and I can fight another battle at the same level."

Hearing Ling Qie's words, a smile appeared on Bai Xu's pale face and nodded, "Sure."

"You are all showing off, it's my turn."

Xuan Si smiled and then prepared to go on stage.

At this time, a sound sounded and instantly spread throughout the entire Huangcheng Square.

"Previous Palace Ting, come and challenge!"
